items.informal_description: In an ordered commutative monoid with zero $M$ equipped with a preorder where $0 \leq 1$ and multiplication is monotonic for non-negative elements, if each element $f(i)$ in the finite product satisfies $1 \leq f(i)$, then the product $\prod_{i} f(i)$ is also greater than or equal to $1$.

items.informal_description: For any commutative monoid with zero $M$ equipped with a preorder where $0 \leq 1$ and multiplication is monotonic for non-negative elements, if each element in the image of a function $f$ over a finite set $s$ satisfies $1 \leq f(i)$, then the product $\prod_{i \in s} f(i)$ satisfies $1 \leq \prod_{i \in s} f(i)$.
